NewsArticle.Title: Server maintenance on Friday at 11am
NewsArticle.Content: Due to unforseen technical troubles, the upgrade scheduled for early this morning did not take place. We are currently performing the maintenance and the system will be available at 12pm PST. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
